title: 第12章 咱们儿子
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 徐喜弟眼睛立刻就红了。婆婆一走，她不就完了嘛？借子这件事，本来她也是被迫的，结果公婆吵起来，婆婆就要把这家撂给她。“妈，你要走带我一起走，我是你养大的，我只跟着你。”徐喜弟捏着自己的良心，闭着眼说道。反正想让她一个人养着两个废物，她想都不敢想。也不知道她肚子现在怀没怀上，要是怀上了，更要命，大着肚子还要养两个废物。范金花看着徐喜弟通红的眼，心里总算熨帖了，自己没白养她。自己带着她和巴儿姐，随便开荒几亩地，都比现在滋润百倍。可是不行。“你跟我走，阿福就没人照顾了，张国海也不会让你走的。”“那我们带阿福一起走，腿长我身上，妈去哪儿，我去哪儿……”徐喜弟说得斩钉截铁，她必须黏着范金花。范金花心里又舒坦了许多，忽然喃喃说道，“阿福这个样子，也不知道还能吃几天饭，不适合跟着我们奔波……”徐喜弟扫了一眼门缝，有个鬼祟的身影在外面晃动，她想了想，“那咱们留下来陪阿福过完最后的日子，然后再走……”范金花叹了一口气，没说话。很快，后院响起了砰砰锤衣服的声音。“妈，两口子就没有不吵架的，您心里有牵挂，这个时候就是走了，心里也不痛快。”徐喜弟站起身，从破烂的柜子上面，翻出半瓶山茶油。然后又从水壶里，倒出热水，兑了兑，开始帮范金花处理头上的伤。好在张国海使不上力，只是崩了皮，两个破口也已经结痂了。用温水清洗后，她就手在伤口上涂山茶油。范金花心里的气，跟着一点点消散，也不说话了。徐喜弟暗暗松了一口气。张国海在后院洗完裤子，晾上后，也不敢叫门，自己默默爬了院墙，绕到前门进屋。……一家子干巴巴围着灶吃了午饭，谁也不说一句话。张国海刚挨了巴儿姐的打，这会儿提都不敢提。吃完饭，他才端着碗去屋里，伺候张永福。“我不吃！叫徐喜弟那个贱人来！”“叫她来！”“我不同意她生孩子！”“她敢怀，我也能给她捶死在肚子里！”张永福骂骂咧咧的声音不绝于耳。“你给老子闭嘴！”张国海憋了一肚子气，这会儿爆发了。“自己张嘴吃，还是我给你灌进去？”“今天你要是还敢拉裤子，我明天给你刨个木塞子！”“治不了那几个妇女，我还收拾不了你？！”呜呜呜~张永福哭了，也不知被气的还被吓的。范金花已经站起身了，但她想了想，最后又坐回去。这两父子，就不能再惯着！“喜弟，你以后就只管怀孩子，养孩子。永福的事，从今天开始，只归他爹管！”范金花几乎是咬着牙说的，还故意放大了嗓，让屋里的两个男人听见。说完她端着空碗筷起身，哐一下丢盆里，然后去舀猪食，一边手一桶提了出去。徐喜弟还愣在那里，怔怔看着范金花的背影。不用照顾张永福了？这是气话还是认真的？巴儿姐吃过午饭，被徐喜弟盯着洗碗。虽然不情愿，但她还是照做了。……在自家吃过晚饭，刘宇宁捏着二十块钱上刘烨家。来到门口，却看到屋里没点灯。他看着手里的钱，来都来了，怎么也得把说好的钱拿给他。于是他上前敲门。很快，刘烨就光着膀子过来开门，看到刘宇宁很诧异。“宇宁？你不是家里来客人了吗？我还以为你没空过来呢……”“说好的过来，再晚也要来的。”刘宇宁笑着回答。“行，那进来说……”刘烨转身进屋，很快油灯就点亮了。灯一亮，刘宇宁就被刘烨的一身腱子肉惊住了。“哥，你这体格，厉害啊！我练几年，都没这么硬。”一边说着，一边就上手又捏又捶的。“掰个手腕试试？”刘烨捏着拳头，在刘烨面前亮了亮，小臂立马就拱出来一座座山丘。“今天必须试试！”刘宇宁撩起衣袖，露出自己略逊一筹的手臂。两人找了个板凳，就蹲在地上。“一二三！”刘烨对刘宇宁的臂力是了解的，心里还停留在从前的轻视态度上。但没想到，两手交握开始，他就知道这小子长大了。两人绷着一身的筋，好几次刘烨差点就被按下去了，最后又咬牙给掰回中间。反复几个来回后，刘烨牛劲上来了，昂了一声，终于把刘宇宁的手腕按在板凳上。“行啊，你小子没少努力。”刘烨喘着气，险胜。可刘宇宁不服，他好几次差点就赢了，“哥，再来一次，再来一次！”刘烨哼了一声，“不！一次定输赢！我的力气省着有用，才不跟你浪费在这里。”此时他们都不知道，两人之间未来的输赢，也跟这次掰手腕一样。“哥，给我赢一次吧？不然我回去睡不着。”刘宇宁摇了摇刘烨的手臂，像撒娇。“不管，我睡得着就行了。我去拿酒……”刘烨丝毫不给他翻身的机会，转身拿酒去了。……没有菜，两个人就坐在堂屋，一人一杯。“哥，我今天在家也喝了点，这酒我先尝尝，剩的等过年回来喝。”“还有，这里有二十块钱，你有空先找媒人问问，等有谱了，你到镇上单位找我。”刘宇宁从裤兜里掏出那二十块钱，交到刘烨手上。刘烨接过钱，神情复杂地看着他。……徐喜弟一直盯着房门口看，不知不觉就进入了梦乡。她梦见傻叔兴高采烈地拉着她去小羊山，骄傲地说，“有了这个山头，咱们儿子以后就不愁吃穿了！”“咱们儿子？”她被惊住了。“阿福没几天日子了，他一走，往后的日子就是咱们的。”刘烨一脸憧憬，最后低头目光灼灼看着她。然后她鬼使神差地闭上双眼。很快，她又睁开眼，一股淡淡的酒味清晰送入鼻中。他又来了，明显喝了酒，此刻很急切。吮着她的耳垂。
content_en: Xu Xidi's eyes immediately turned red.Once her mother-in-law leaves, won't she be finished?She was originally forced to borrow a child, but when her parents-in-law quarreled, her mother-in-law decided to abandon the family to her."Mom, if you want to leave, take me with you. I was raised by you and I will only follow you." Xu Xidi pinched his conscience and closed his eyes as he said.Anyway, she couldn't even think about raising two losers by herself.I don't know if she is pregnant now. If she is pregnant, it will be even worse. She will have to raise two wastes with a big belly.Fan Jinhua looked at Xu Xidi's red eyes and finally felt convinced that she had not raised her in vain.If I take her and Sister Ba'er with me to open up a few acres of land, it will be a hundred times more moist than it is now.But no."If you come with me, Ah Fu will have no one to take care of you, and Zhang Guohai won't let you go." "Then let's take Ah Fu with us. My legs will grow on me. Wherever mom goes, I will go..." Xu Xidi said firmly, she must stick to Fan Jinhua.Fan Jinhua felt much more at ease, and suddenly murmured, "Afu looks like this, and he doesn't know how many days he can eat, so he is not suitable for running around with us..." Xu Xidi glanced at the crack in the door, and there was a sneaky figure wandering outside. She thought for a while, "Then let's stay and spend the last days with Afu, and then leave..." Fan Jinhua sighed and said nothing.Soon, the sound of hammering clothes could be heard in the backyard."Mom, couples always quarrel. You have concerns in your heart. Even if you leave at this time, you won't feel happy." Xu Xidi stood up and took out half a bottle of camellia oil from the tattered cabinet.Then he poured hot water from the kettle, mixed it, and began to help Fan Jinhua treat the injury on his head.Fortunately, Zhang Guohai couldn't use any force, but the skin only cracked, and the two wounds were already scabbed.After washing it with warm water, she applied camellia oil to the wound.Fan Jinhua's anger gradually dissipated and she stopped talking.Xu Xidi secretly breathed a sigh of relief.After Zhang Guohai washed his pants in the backyard and hung them to dry, he didn't dare to call the door. He silently climbed up the courtyard wall and walked around to the front door to enter the house....The whole family had lunch dryly around the stove, without anyone saying a word.Zhang Guohai had just been beaten by Sister Ba'er, and he didn't dare to mention it now.After eating, he took the bowl to the room and served Zhang Yongfu."I don't want to eat! Call that bitch Xu Xidi!" "Call her!" "I don't agree with her having a baby!" "If she dares to get pregnant, I will beat her to death in her belly!" Zhang Yongfu's cursing voice could not be heard."Shut up!" Zhang Guohai had been holding back his anger, and now he exploded."Open your mouth and eat it, or should I pour it in for you?" "If you dare to poop your pants today, I will dig a cork for you tomorrow!" "I can't cure those women, so I can't cure you?!" Wuwuwu~ Zhang Yongfu cried, and he didn't know whether he was angry or frightened.Fan Jinhua had already stood up, but she thought about it and finally sat back down.These two father and son can no longer be spoiled!"Brother Xi, from now on you will only care about conceiving and raising children. From today on, Yongfu's affairs will only be under the control of his father!" Fan Jinhua almost said through gritted teeth, and deliberately raised her voice to let the two men in the room hear.After saying that, she stood up with the empty bowl and chopsticks, threw them into the basin with a bang, then went to scoop up the pig food, carrying a bucket out with her hand.Xu Xidi was still there, staring blankly at Fan Jinhua's back.No need to take care of Zhang Yongfu?Is this an angry comment or is it serious?After Sister Ba'er had lunch, Xu Xidi was watching her wash the dishes.Although reluctant, she did it anyway....After dinner at his home, Liu Yuning went to Liu Ye's house with twenty yuan in hand.When I came to the door, I saw that there was no light in the room.He looked at the money in his hand and realized that even though it had come, he still had to give him the money he had promised.So he went up and knocked on the door.Soon, Liu Ye came over to open the door shirtless, and was surprised to see Liu Yuning."Yuning? Aren't you a guest at home? I thought you didn't have time to come over..." "I promised to come over, and I will come no matter how late it is." Liu Yuning replied with a smile."Okay, then come in and talk..." Liu Ye turned around and entered the room, and soon the oil lamp was lit.As soon as the lights came on, Liu Yuning was shocked by Liu Ye's body."Brother, your physique is amazing! I have been practicing for several years and it has never been this hard." As he said this, he began to squeeze and pound."Try breaking your wrist?" Liu Ye clenched his fist and flashed it in front of Liu Ye, and his forearm immediately arched out into hills."I have to try it today!" Liu Yuning lifted up his sleeves, revealing his slightly inferior arms.The two found a bench and squatted on the ground."One, two, three!" Liu Ye knew Liu Yuning's arm strength, but his previous contemptuous attitude remained in his heart.But he didn't expect that as soon as his hands clasped together, he knew that this kid had grown up.The two of them were tense, and Liu Ye was almost pressed down several times, but finally he was forced back to the middle through gritted teeth.After several back and forths, Liu Ye got stronger and finally pressed Liu Yuning's wrist to the bench with a loud voice."Okay, you guys worked hard." Liu Ye gasped and narrowly won.But Liu Yuning refused to accept it. He almost won several times, "Brother, do it again, do it again!" Liu Ye snorted, "No! One time will determine the outcome! I save my strength and use it, so I don't waste it here with you." At this time, they didn't know that the future winning or losing between the two would be the same as this fight."Brother, can you win for me once? Otherwise I won't be able to sleep when I go back." Liu Yuning shook Liu Ye's arm like a baby."It doesn't matter, as long as I can sleep. I'm going to get the wine..." Liu Ye didn't give him a chance to turn over, and turned around to get the wine....There was no food, so the two of them sat in the main room, each having a cup."Brother, I drank some at home today. I'll try this wine first and drink the rest when I get back during the Chinese New Year." "Also, there are twenty yuan here. You can ask the matchmaker when you have time. When you have the information, you can find me at the work unit in the town." Liu Yuning took out the twenty yuan from his trouser pocket and handed it to Liu Ye.Liu Ye took the money and looked at him with a complicated expression....Xu Xidi kept staring at the door of the room and fell asleep unconsciously.She dreamed that Uncle Silly happily took her to Xiaoyang Mountain and said proudly, "With this mountain, our son will not have to worry about food and clothing in the future!" "Our son?" She was shocked."Ah Fu only has a few days to live. Once he leaves, the rest of his life will be ours." Liu Ye looked longingly, and finally lowered his head and looked at her with burning eyes.Then she closed her eyes in a strange way.Soon, she opened her eyes again, and a faint smell of alcohol clearly entered her nose.There he was again, obviously drunk and now very eager.Sucking her earlobe.
